description: Request quote-first human execution for an outcome whose real cost depends on scope, feasibility, urgency or real-world conditions. Submit the result your agent needs, expected deliverables and constraints; no funds are committed at this stage. HumanEndpoint reviews the work and returns explicit commercial terms that the agent can accept or decline before payment. Provide callback_url to receive signed quote.offered or quote.declined webhooks instead of relying only on polling. Suitable tasks include calling a business for current price, stock, lead time or availability; retrieving information only available by phone; verifying a real-world fact; checking AI output; applying human judgement; doing bounded research; or carrying out a physical-world task. If no named service matches, set service_slug to custom-human-task.
name: human_request_quote
title: Request human task quote
